facets.description: poll_feed.rb line 35: i.content.scrub has no guard for items without content (nil), so one such item raises NoMethodError and aborts the whole items loop; retry: false means the remaining items are never imported
String#scrub only exists on Ruby >= 2.1, so i.content.scrub can raise NoMethodError on older supported Ruby versions even when content exists
A nil i.title is passed to TopicEmbed.import/PostCreator with skip_validations: true, so the insert fails on a null title
